sections.label: Method
sections.description: Correlation algorithm (tttrlib). laurence: pair counting with symmetric normalization, no long-lag upturn when the intensity drifts (the default). wahl: multiple-tau on the time tags. felekyan: the Felekyan variant with its own lag axis.
